plans.rationale: Initial round to establish the exact symptom onset and check telemetry for the reported services, alongside a broad sweep of recent changes and dependency mapping around mobile-bff and payments-api.

tasks.goal: Check error rates, latency metrics, and logs for mobile-bff and payments-api to establish symptom onset and the exact nature of the UPI payment failures.

r1-observability-1.summary: Mobile-bff and payments-api experienced an error rate surge starting at 2026-10-02T14:03:00Z due to a NullPointerException in payments-api regarding payer_vpa being null during UPI payment intent validation.

findings.statement: mobile-bff error rate started increasing at 2026-10-02T14:03:00Z, reaching a peak of 6.29% at 14:09:00Z.
payments-api error rate started increasing at 2026-10-02T14:03:00Z, reaching a peak of 20.29% at 14:07:00Z.
payments-api CPU usage increased starting at 2026-10-02T14:03:00Z, peaking at 48.63% at 14:19:00Z.
mobile-bff logged upstream errors indicating payments-api responded with 500 for POST /v1/payments/intent starting at 2026-10-02T14:03:01Z.
payments-api logged NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 where payer_vpa is null, starting at 2026-10-02T14:03:05Z.

open_questions: Why did payer_vpa start being null in payment intents received by payments-api?

r1-dependency-2.summary: Mapped direct dependencies for mobile-bff, payments-api, and upi-gateway, and retrieved change logs over the past week. Identified a critical deploy chg-9890 on payments-api at 14:02 UTC, just three minutes before the reported symptom onset.

findings.statement: mobile-bff makes synchronous calls to auth-service, payments-api, portfolio-service, orders-service, kyc-service, and aa-connector.
payments-api makes synchronous calls to ledger-service, upi-gateway, fraud-service, and redis-cache, and asynchronous calls to event-bus.
upi-gateway makes synchronous calls to npci-switch and partner-bank-api.

A deploy for payments-api (v2.14.0, refactor payment-intent validation, bump json library) occurred at 2026-10-02T14:02:00+00:00 (chg-9890), shortly before symptoms were reported starting around 14:05.
Other recent changes on the day of the incident include market-data-service deploys (chg-9177, chg-9557) and user-db deploy (chg-8908).

open_questions: What specific error logs or status code distributions are occurring on payments-api and mobile-bff following the 14:02 deploy?
Are external dependencies like npci-switch or partner-bank-api experiencing elevated failure rates?

hypotheses.title: Payments-API Refactor Bad Deploy
hypotheses.mechanism: The deployment of payments-api v2.14.0 (chg-9890) at 14:02 UTC introduced a regression in PaymentIntentValidator (PaymentIntentValidator.java:88), causing a NullPointerException whenever payer_vpa is accessed during intent validation, resulting in 500 errors starting at 14:03 UTC.

supporting.note: Deploy of v2.14.0 at 14:02 UTC immediately preceded the onset of errors at 14:03 UTC.
Payments-api error rate surged starting at 14:03 UTC.
Mobile-bff error rate surged starting at 14:03 UTC.
Mobile-bff logged upstream errors indicating payments-api responded with 500 starting at 14:03 UTC.
Payments-api logged NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 regarding payer_vpa being null starting at 14:03 UTC.

assumptions: The refactored payment-intent validation logic in v2.14.0 incorrectly handles or strips the deserialization of payer_vpa under certain request payloads or json library behaviors.

hypotheses.title: Mobile-BFF Client Payload Schema Change
hypotheses.mechanism: Mobile-bff clients changed their request payload structure simultaneously with the payments-api deploy, omitting the payer_vpa field and causing validation to crash.

contradicting.note: Logs explicitly attribute the NullPointerException to payments-api internal validator code (PaymentIntentValidator.java:88), and no mobile-bff deployment occurred around that time.

assumptions: Mobile client or mobile-bff proxy layer modified the outgoing payload format right after 14:00.

hypotheses.reasoning_summary: The symptom onset is definitively established at 2026-10-02T14:03:00Z, where error rates for both mobile-bff and payments-api surged (metric:mobile-bff:error_rate_pct, metric:payments-api:error_rate_pct). A deploy on payments-api (chg-9890) occurred at 14:02:00Z—just one minute prior—with the commit message 'refactor payment-intent validation, bump json library'. Immediately following at 14:03:05Z, payments-api began logging NullPointerExceptions at PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 due to payer_vpa being null (log-00759), causing 500 errors upstream on mobile-bff (log-00758). The timeline, service logs, and direct temporal precedence point overwhelmingly to H1 (bad deploy).

adjustments.reason: Direct temporal precedence with deploy chg-9890 at 14:02 UTC, immediate error onset at 14:03 UTC in both mobile-bff and payments-api, and explicit log evidence pointing to a NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 in the newly deployed version.

Contradicted by direct log evidence showing internal null pointer exception in payments-api validator code following its own code and library refactor deploy, with no concurrent mobile client payload or BFF changes.
